annotations.title: Check if ChatGPT recommends an app

description: Asks ChatGPT (with web search) up to three generic questions a person would ask when looking for an app like this one, with the app's name left out (e.g. "What's the best app to learn a new language?"), and says whether it names the app, at what position, and which apps it recommends instead. Answers are reused for a week.

country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de...). Defaults to the link's country, else us.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id570060128
